caption: The drawing depicts a group of people, most of whom are dressed in red coats with gold trim, blue trousers, and tall, pointed hats in various colors including red, blue, and green. The central figure, with long brown hair and a beard, is wearing a reddish tunic and light blue shorts; he is carrying a large wooden crossbeam on his shoulder with the assistance of others. Another man, dressed in light tan or brownish robes, is positioned just in front of the central figure and appears to be supporting the cross. The background consists of tall, vertical rods or bars and what appears to be a building or architectural structure on the right side. A black horse with a bridle is visible on the far left next to a figure in a long blue garment. There are also several figures in the background, some wearing blue hats and tunics. The composition is dense with overlapping figures, most of whom are looking toward the central activity around the cross. The upper left corner contains handwritten text that reads, "#2. The Cross is laid on Jesus."
title: Station of the Cross No. 2: "The Cross is Laid on Jesus
